name: Infinite Finance Co., Ltd.
summary: Infinite Finance Co., Ltd. provides vehicle-related services for heavy motorcycles, tour buses, vans, and small passenger cars. It also offers vehicles installments, construction equipment installments, industrial equipment installments, letter of credit for imported machinery, long-term car leasing, real estate lease, installment loans for and rental of large heavy machinery, green energy financing, accounts receivable transfer, and other services. The company was formerly known as Jih Sun Formosa Auto Leasing CO., LTD and changed its name to Infinite Finance Co., Ltd. in 2010. Infinite Finance Co., Ltd. was founded in 1981 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
